motivation: The cavity-frozen MV16B map failed zero-shot cylinder transfer. MV17A implements the predeclared second path: geometry-native development using existing cylinder seeds before any new DSMC confirmation.

cylinder_native_contract.transform: cylinder-centred polar normal/tangential coordinates with rectangular-ray-normalised radius

primary_endpoints.near_wall_q_n: correct cylinder-centred normal heat flux on cells within 0.05D of the wall
primary_endpoints.baseline: independent Raw DSMC B=10 observation seed evaluated against the same disjoint B10 reference seed

negative_controls.peer_prior_only: two-training-seed Raw B10 mean without observation residual
negative_controls.phase_scrambled_observation: fixed-sign DCT phase scramble of the B3 residual with DC preserved
negative_controls.legacy_cavity_zero_shot: MV16B mask-aware cavity-frozen transfer retained only as a failed comparator

known_limitations: The original MV11 cylinder trajectories stopped near tU/D=11.5 rather than the requested tU/D=30.
Only four independent observation seeds exist; the minimum one-sided exact sign-test p-value is 0.0625.
The geometry-specific peer prior uses existing cylinder B10 development trajectories and is not zero-shot transfer.
MV16B near-wall q_n used the coordinate origin instead of the actual cylinder centre; MV17A corrects that metric and does not reuse the erroneous mask.
